episodes.title: The Nucleus
episodes.description: Explore atomic particles and the nucleus's role in determining the properties of matter.

episodes.title: Unit Conversion & Significant Figures
episodes.description: Learn how shared units and careful precision help scientists communicate physical measurements.

episodes.title: The Creation of Chemistry – The Fundamental Laws
episodes.description: Trace chemistry's development from alchemy through conservation of mass and knowledge of atoms and compounds.

episodes.title: The Periodic Table
episodes.description: Explore Mendeleev's work and learn to read the information organized in the periodic table.

episodes.title: The Electron
episodes.description: Connect electron arrangements and energy changes with patterns among chemical elements.

episodes.title: Stoichiometry – Chemistry for Massive Creatures
episodes.description: Learn how chemical proportions make reactions understandable at practical, measurable scales.

episodes.title: Water and Solutions – for Dirty Laundry
episodes.description: Explore water's importance as the setting for reactions in living organisms and Earth's environment.

episodes.title: Acid-Base Reactions in Solution
episodes.description: Investigate proton transfers and the rearrangement of atoms in acidic and basic solutions.

episodes.title: Precipitation Reactions
episodes.description: Explore how dissolved ions combine into insoluble products and how to describe those reactions.

episodes.title: Redox Reactions
episodes.description: Connect electron gains and losses with energy transfer in oxidation-reduction chemistry.

episodes.title: How To Speak Chemistrian
episodes.description: Learn rules and language that make chemical ideas easier to name and discuss.

episodes.title: The Ideal Gas Law
episodes.description: Explore the history and mathematical relationships behind idealized gas behavior.

episodes.title: Ideal Gas Problems
episodes.description: Practice calculations with the ideal gas law while recognizing its assumptions about particle size and attraction.

episodes.title: Real Gases
episodes.description: Adjust gas models to account for occupied volume and interactions between real particles.

episodes.title: Partial Pressures & Vapor Pressure
episodes.description: Explore mixed-gas pressures, vapor pressure, and experiments collecting gas over water.

episodes.title: Passing Gases – Effusion, Diffusion and the Velocity of a Gas
episodes.description: Investigate molecular speed, diffusion, effusion, and the effects of concentration differences.

episodes.title: Energy & Chemistry
episodes.description: Connect chemical processes with thermodynamic energy through a mechanical demonstration.

episodes.title: Enthalpy
episodes.description: Explore enthalpy as a way of understanding energy associated with chemical bonds and changes.

episodes.title: Calorimetry
episodes.description: Learn ways to calculate enthalpy and measure it through experiments.

episodes.title: Entropy – Embrace the Chaos!
episodes.description: Connect probability and disordered arrangements with entropy and thermodynamic behavior.

episodes.title: Lab Techniques & Safety
episodes.description: Explore protective equipment, chemical disposal, hazard information, and practical techniques for laboratory work.

episodes.title: Atomic Hook-Ups – Types of Chemical Bonds
episodes.description: Compare chemical bond types through attraction, charge, and distances between atoms.

episodes.title: Polar & Non-Polar Molecules
episodes.description: Explore how molecular structure and charge distribution distinguish polar from nonpolar substances.

episodes.title: Bonding Models and Lewis Structures
episodes.description: Use Lewis structures to consider both the usefulness and limitations of chemical models.

episodes.title: Orbitals
episodes.description: Explore molecular shape, orbital hybridization, and the distinction between sigma and pi bonding.

episodes.title: Liquids
episodes.description: Connect liquid behavior with intermolecular attractions, viscosity, surface tension, and capillary effects.

episodes.title: Solutions
episodes.description: Explore concentration measures, solvent interactions, and the behavior of dissolved gases.

episodes.title: Equilibrium
episodes.description: Investigate how concentration, pressure, and temperature influence chemical equilibrium.

episodes.title: Equilibrium Equations
episodes.description: Calculate equilibrium conditions and constants using organized reaction tables.

episodes.title: pH and pOH
episodes.description: Connect water dissociation, acid strength, logarithms, and calculations of acidity and basicity.

episodes.title: Buffers, the Acid Rain Slayer
episodes.description: Explore buffer composition, natural carbonate systems, titration, and resistance to acidity changes.

episodes.title: Kinetics – Chemistry’s Demolition Derby
episodes.description: Investigate reaction rates through collisions, activation barriers, mechanisms, and slow steps.

episodes.title: Doing Solids
episodes.description: Compare solid structures and connect their properties with the bonds holding them together.

episodes.title: Network Solids and Carbon
episodes.description: Explore carbon networks through graphite, diamond, sheets, and three-dimensional structures.

episodes.title: Silicon – The Internet’s Favorite Element
episodes.description: Connect silicon's solid networks with semiconductors, diodes, transistors, and computer chips.

episodes.title: Electrochemistry
episodes.description: Explore reactions that power batteries and connect cell potential with electrolysis and plating.

episodes.title: The History of Atomic Chemistry
episodes.description: Trace thinkers whose work contributed to the modern understanding of atoms.

episodes.title: Nuclear Chemistry
episodes.description: Explore isotopes, changes between elements, half-life calculations, radioactive decay, and fission.

episodes.title: Nuclear Chemistry, Part 2 – Fusion and Fission
episodes.description: Compare splitting and combining nuclei, their energy changes, uses, and dangers.

episodes.title: Hydrocarbon Power!
episodes.description: Introduce organic compounds through hydrocarbon structures, alkane properties, isomers, and naming.

episodes.title: Alkenes & Alkynes
episodes.description: Compare unsaturated hydrocarbons and reactions involving hydrogenation, halogenation, and polymer formation.

episodes.title: Aromatics and Cyclic Compounds
episodes.description: Explore cyclic and aromatic molecules, resonance, substituents, reactions, and practical uses.

episodes.title: Hydrocarbon Derivatives
episodes.description: Investigate functional groups and the ways they change hydrocarbon-derived compounds.

episodes.title: Nomenclature
episodes.description: Use systematic naming rules to describe carbon chains, functional priorities, and double-bond arrangements.

episodes.title: Polymers
episodes.description: Explore the development and varied everyday uses of large-chain molecular materials.

episodes.title: The Global Carbon Cycle
episodes.description: Follow carbon through global processes, including fixation and oxidation-reduction reactions.
